step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features three sections: Cluster, DevOps, and Management. The Cluster section contains a user/client accessing an ALB, Cognito, and EC2 instance. EC2 connects to EFS and S2S VPN. The DevOps section contains S3, API Gateway, and Lambda. The Management section shows AWS Control Tower enforcing policies on AWS Organizations.
